persona.name: Rina Wulandari
persona.background: Kelas 12 at a state SMA in 2017, father runs a motorbike bengkel, mother sells sayur at Pasar Setonobetek. Music came through YouTube and Joox on a cheap Android phone on daily quota, Indosiar's D'Academy and dangdut award shows on the family TV, local radio, koplo stages (OM-style orchestras) at neighbours' hajatan and 17 Agustus events, and whatever the angkot and warung speakers were playing.

ID2017A.wouldSay: Akad, terus Sayang, terus Jaran Goyang — ini 2017 banget, kelas dua belas, semua orang nyanyi ini di kantin sama di nikahan tetangga.
missing: Ayu Ting Ting - Kamu Kamu Kamu (2017)
ID2017A.fake: Almost nothing; only Tulus - Pamit is a 2016 single (released Feb 2016), so it reads as last year's song rather than 2017's.
ID2017A.missingScene: TV dangdut from Indosiar (D'Academy stars like Lesti and Fildan) and the Starla/Virgoun wedding-song wave are absent; the koplo side rests on two songs only.

seeds.song: Luis Fonsi, Daddy Yankee, Justin Bieber - Despacito - Remix
The Chainsmokers, Coldplay - Something Just Like This
Ayu Ting Ting - Kamu Kamu Kamu

ID2017B.wouldSay: Asal Kau Bahagia langsung Sayang — ya ampun, ini lagu yang diputar terus di YouTube tahun 2017, dari pagi sampai malam.
missing: Hivi! - Siapkah Kau 'Tuk Jatuh Cinta Lagi (2017)
ID2017B.fake: Agnez Mo - Long As I Get Paid is an English-language international single that got news coverage but was never played around me; it is the one seed chosen for the artist's fame rather than for being heard.
ID2017B.missingScene: Koplo is there but thin beyond Via and Nella (no Javanese-language koplo stage songs, no campursari), and nothing religious (sholawat/qasidah) that school and pengajian played.

persona.name: Fajar Nugroho
persona.background: SMK student in 2020 doing sekolah daring from home during the pandemic; father a mandor at a building-materials shop, mother runs a warung kopi. Music came through TikTok and YouTube on a phone, free Spotify, LIDA and dangdut shows on Indosiar, the Lathi challenge, the wave of Didi Kempot tributes after his death in May 2020, and the koplo his friends played at nongkrong spots once hajatan were cancelled under PSBB.

seeds.song: BTS - 작은 것들을 위한 시 (Boy With Luv)

ID2020A.wouldSay: To the Bone iya, 2020 banget, tapi Meraih Bintang itu Asian Games 2018 dan Sayang itu jaman aku SMP — kok tahun corona isinya lagu lama?
ID2020A.fake: Its only dangdut is two Via Vallen songs from 2017 and 2018, so the Javanese/koplo side of 2020 (Lathi, Los Dol, the Didi Kempot ambyar mourning) is replaced by a generic 'Indonesia = Via Vallen' shorthand.
ID2020A.missingScene: The Sobat Ambyar/Didi Kempot wave and his death in May 2020, Javanese koplo (Denny Caknan), TikTok viral hits like Lathi, and the pandemic-era galau Spotify ballads (Mahen, Hindia, Andmesh) are all missing.

Fiersa Besari, Thantri - Waktu Yang Salah
Bunga Citra Lestari, Ariel NOAH - Menghapus Jejakmu

ID2020B.wouldSay: Pura Pura Lupa, Secukupnya, terus Lathi — ini tahun sekolah online, rebahan di rumah sambil scroll TikTok.
ID2020B.fake: Mostly convincing; it leans on Spotify-chart ballads, and Andmesh's Cinta Luar Biasa peaked in 2019 rather than 2020.
ID2020B.missingScene: Only one koplo song (Los Dol); the Didi Kempot ambyar mourning, which was the biggest regional music moment of 2020, is absent, as are TV dangdut (LIDA) and sholawat.

persona.name: Salsabila Rahmawati
persona.background: Kelas 11 at a madrasah aliyah in 2023; father a teacher, mother sells kerudung online. Music came through TikTok sounds and Reels, Spotify free, YouTube covers, Indonesian Idol on RCTI, organ tunggal and koplo at relatives' weddings, sholawat at the pesantren events, and K-pop through friends' fandom group chats.

ID2023A.wouldSay: Tak Segampang Itu, terus Nemen, terus Kill Bill — ini persis isi FYP TikTok tahun 2023, sama yang diputar di kondangan sepupu.
missing: Sherina - Mengapa Bintang Bersinar (2023 search hit)
ID2023A.fake: Little feels fake; Putri Ariani's Loneliness was a viral AGT moment that people searched for more than a song they played on repeat, and I am unsure Jaz - Bersamamu was a 2023 hit rather than an older wedding staple.
ID2023A.missingScene: Koplo is covered (Nemen, Kalih Welasku), but Sundanese pop, organ-tunggal wedding dangdut and the viral sholawat/religious pop of that year are absent.

seeds.song: Stephen Sanchez - Until I Found You

ID2023B.wouldSay: Tak Ingin Usai, Hati-Hati di Jalan, Runtuh — ini Spotify Wrapped 2022, akhir kelas sepuluh; 2023-ku itu Komang sama Sial, bukan ini.
ID2023B.fake: It is the 2022 Spotify Wrapped list (Hati-Hati di Jalan, Runtuh, Tak Ingin Usai, Sisa Rasa, Angel Baby were 2022's top five) moved forward a year, and it is all slow galau ballads with no dangdut or koplo.
ID2023B.missingScene: No dangdut, koplo or Javanese songs at all (Nemen and Kalih Welasku were everywhere in 2023), no K-pop, and none of 2023's own viral songs except Tak Segampang Itu and Until I Found You.
